title: Women's Gym – Lunges & Lattes Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Coffee Gym Zip Up Hoodie – Lunges & Lattes
seo.description: A coffee gym zip up hoodie: LUNGES & LATTES on the back beside a lunging bunny with a dumbbell and a latte, plus an embroidered coffee cup on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This coffee gym zip up hoodie is for the woman who lunges first and lattes right after, zipped on for the early class and the coffee line on the way home.

A sleepy bunny in a pink headband, striped leotard and leg warmers lunges with a pink dumbbell in one paw and an iced latte with whipped cream in the other, in black, pink, cream and brown with a worn print texture. LUNGES & stands in heavy rounded capitals beside the bunny with LATTES beneath it, the second line a touch wider than the first: pink and cream on Black and Navy, brown and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small iced coffee cup with a dumbbell beside it is embroidered on the left chest, and the word LATTES is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest coffee cup and dumbbell and left-cuff LATTES, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Lunges & Lattes zip hoodie fit?
The Lunges & Lattes coffee gym zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this coffee gym hoodie warm enough for early gym mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles early gym mornings, cold parking lots and the coffee run after class well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, LUNGES & LATTES in heavy capitals beside the bunny, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small iced coffee cup with a dumbbell beside it sits on the left chest with no words, and LATTES is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The coffee cup and dumbbell on the chest and the LATTES cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a gym friend, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who treats the coffee as part of the workout. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
